project.title: Standardise Assembly Line Changeover and Ergonomic Routines
project.objective: Design and roll out a standard changeover and ergonomic work routine for the motor parts assembly line to reduce downtime and minor incidents.
deliverables: Documented standard operating procedure for assembly line changeover
Ergonomic workstation checklist and rotation schedule
Training briefings for all assembly workers on new routines
Visual aids and quick-reference guides posted on the shop floor
Simple incident and near-miss reporting log for the line
constraints: All changes must fit within existing shift patterns and break times
No additional headcount or major equipment purchases allowed
Procedures must comply with workplace safety and ergonomic guidelines
Pilot must be completed on one line before scaling to others
Documentation must be understandable for all literacy levels on the floor

risks.risk: Assembly workers resist new routines and keep old habits.
risks.mitigation: Involve workers in drafting SOPs, run short floor briefings, and collect feedback in the first weeks.

risks.risk: New changeover steps increase cycle time and reduce output.
risks.mitigation: Pilot on one line, time each step, and remove non-essential actions before full rollout.

risks.risk: Inconsistent application of ergonomic checklist across shifts.
risks.mitigation: Create simple visual checklist, assign shift champions, and review logs weekly with supervisor.

risks.risk: Poor documentation leads to misunderstandings and unsafe shortcuts.
risks.mitigation: Use photos and simple language, test materials with a small group, and adjust based on questions raised.

themes.why_relevant: Core of the project; defines how the line is prepared between product runs.
Participants have care and handling skills that can reduce strain and incidents.
Procedures must work across all shifts and rotation patterns without extra staff.
Guides and checklists must be easy to follow on the shop floor under time pressure.
New routines may affect recorded hours, overtime, and allowances managed by payroll.

backlog.task: Map current assembly line changeover steps for one pilot line
definition_of_done: All current steps listed in order with approximate times
Bottlenecks and unsafe shortcuts noted
List validated by at least two assemblers from different shifts

backlog.task: Draft standard operating procedure for changeover on pilot line
definition_of_done: SOP includes step-by-step actions, roles, and safety checks
SOP reviewed with production supervisor and safety officer
Unclear or duplicate steps removed or clarified

backlog.task: Create ergonomic workstation checklist for assembly tasks
definition_of_done: Checklist covers posture, lifting, reach, and tool placement
Items can be completed in under 5 minutes at shift start
Checklist validated by health and safety officer

backlog.task: Design simple rotation schedule to reduce repetitive strain
definition_of_done: Rotation pattern defined for at least three key stations
Schedule fits within existing shift and break structure
Workers from pilot line confirm schedule is workable

backlog.task: Prepare visual quick-reference guides for new changeover SOP
definition_of_done: Guide uses photos or diagrams for each key step
Language simplified and checked by at least two peers
Print-ready version approved by production supervisor

backlog.task: Set up incident and near-miss reporting log for pilot line
definition_of_done: Log format defined with date, station, brief description, and action taken
Location and access method agreed with supervisor
Team briefed on when and how to record incidents

backlog.task: Define how changeover and rotation time will be recorded for payroll
definition_of_done: Rules documented for coding changeover and rotation time
Any overtime or allowance impacts clarified
Production supervisor and payroll clerk agree on approach

backlog.task: Create weekly changeover performance summary template
definition_of_done: Template includes average changeover time and incident count
Data sources and responsible person defined
Template tested with one week of sample data

backlog.task: Run pilot training briefing for new SOP and ergonomic checklist
definition_of_done: Briefing agenda prepared and shared in advance
At least one worker from each shift attends or receives recap
Questions and feedback captured for SOP updates

backlog.task: Collect and review first two weeks of pilot feedback and logs
definition_of_done: Feedback from at least three workers summarised
Incident and near-miss entries reviewed for patterns
List of proposed SOP and checklist adjustments created

backlog.task: Update SOP and guides based on pilot results
definition_of_done: Changes clearly marked and versioned
Updated documents revalidated with supervisor and safety officer
Old versions removed from shop floor locations

backlog.task: Confirm payroll and timekeeping alignment before wider rollout
definition_of_done: No conflicting rules between shifts on time coding
Sample payslips checked for correct application
Short note prepared for workers explaining any visible changes

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on current changeover steps and pick the pilot line scope.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message asking workers to describe how they currently do changeovers.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select which assembly line and shift will be used as the pilot.
Agree on the level of detail needed in the mapped current-state steps.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Draft and refine the new changeover SOP and visual guides.
threads_plan.trigger: Post first draft of the SOP and ask for quick comments and missing steps.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the first pilot version of the changeover SOP.
Decide which steps must appear on the visual posters versus full SOP.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define ergonomic checklist and rotation schedule for the pilot.
threads_plan.trigger: Share initial ergonomic checklist items and rotation ideas for feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Lock the final list of ergonomic checks for the pilot.
Confirm the rotation pattern and which stations are included.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Clarify time coding, payroll impact, and weekly reporting.
threads_plan.trigger: Payroll clerk asks how new routines will show up in time records.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on time coding rules for changeover and rotation activities.
Approve the weekly performance summary format and owner.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Run pilot check-in, review incidents and feedback, and decide updates.
threads_plan.trigger: End-of-week message asking for pilot feedback and incident highlights.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Decide which SOP and checklist changes to implement after pilot.
Confirm readiness to extend the routines beyond the pilot line.

channel_rituals: Daily quick async check-in at shift start on any changeover or ergonomic issues.
End-of-week pilot recap summarising incidents, feedback, and small wins.
Pre-shift reminder posts on days when SOP or rotation changes go live.
Post-incident short debrief thread linking to the reporting log and next steps.
